package.description: AI text editing anywhere on your desktop

en-US.description: AI text editing anywhere on your desktop
en-US.longDescription: Select text in any app, press a hotkey and pick an action (proofread, rewrite, translate, ...): the result is pasted back in place. Also a Playground, live captions and voice dictation. Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or runs AI models itself (llama.cpp, whisper.cpp) on the GPU.
en-US.name: GhostPen
